# Didi Bhaiya ki Biryani

> 100% vegetarian dum biryani, slow-cooked in sealed copper handis with hand-ground spice and delivered piping hot in about 35 minutes. Tagline: "Har bite, yaad rahe!"

## About
Didi Bhaiya ki Biryani (operated by D&B Foods) is a pure-vegetarian, FSSAI-certified cloud kitchen. Every biryani is dum-cooked to order in a dedicated 100% veg kitchen — no cross-contact with non-veg — and delivered hot in insulated packaging. Delivery only; no dine-in.

## Order
- Website: https://didibhaiyakibiryani.com
- Order online / app: https://native.didibhaiyakibiryani.com

## Menu highlights
- Veg dum biryanis (paneer, kathal/jackfruit, veg, soya), combos, raita, sides and desserts.
- Customisable spice levels and party/bulk orders.
